description: Controls gates and garage doors, either directly or through an external gate controller

inputs.name: Toggle
inputs.description: Single button control. With direct motor control or separate pulses it cycles open, stop, close, stop. With a single control output the pulse is forwarded to the controller which owns the cycle.

inputs.name: Stop
inputs.description: Stops the movement. Available with direct motor control and the open/stop/close controller mode; ignored in controller modes without a stop function.

inputs.name: Partial open
inputs.description: Moves the gate to the partial open position (e.g. pedestrian or ventilation position), according to the configured partial open mode

inputs.name: Is open
inputs.description: Limit switch reporting the fully open position. Corrects the simulated position and detects externally triggered movement.

inputs.name: Is closed
inputs.description: Limit switch reporting the fully closed position. Corrects the simulated position and detects externally triggered movement.

inputs.name: Prevent opening
inputs.description: Safety sensor input. While active, opening is blocked; an ongoing opening movement is stopped if the control mode allows stopping.

inputs.name: Prevent closing
inputs.description: Safety sensor input, e.g. a photocell. While active, closing is blocked; an ongoing closing movement is stopped if the control mode allows stopping.

inputs.name: Off
inputs.description: Stops the gate when activated and blocks all commands while active

outputs.name: Control pulse
outputs.description: Pulse output for single control input controllers (open/stop/close or open/close cycle)

outputs.name: Open
outputs.description: With direct motor control: level signal driving the motor in the opening direction. With separate pulses: open pulse for the controller.

outputs.name: Close
outputs.description: With direct motor control: level signal driving the motor in the closing direction. With separate pulses: close pulse for the controller.

outputs.name: In motion
outputs.description: Active while the gate is moving

outputs.name: Position
outputs.description: Current gate position as a percentage (0=fully closed, 100=fully open)

config.name: Gate type
config.description: Type of the gate, used for the proper animation in client applications: Garage door, Gate (left wing), Gate (right wing), Double wing gate, Sliding gate (left), Sliding gate (right)

config.name: Control mode
config.description: How the gate is driven: direct motor control (level signals), single pulse output open/stop/close (3F cycle), single pulse output open/close toggle, or separate open and close pulse outputs.

config.name: Opening duration
config.description: The time taken to fully open the gate, in seconds. Used to simulate the gate position.

config.name: Closing duration
config.description: The time taken to fully close the gate, in seconds. Used to simulate the gate position.

config.name: Partial open position
config.description: Target position for the partial open command, as a percentage of fully open (0-100)

config.name: Partial open mode
config.description: With separate pulse outputs: stop at position (requires stop capability), or a close pulse on a fully closed gate interpreted as partial open by the controller (e.g. AWso UZ mode).

config.name: Pulse duration
config.description: Duration of pulses on the control, open and close outputs, in seconds

config.name: Pulse pause
config.description: Minimal pause between two consecutive pulses, in seconds

config.name: Motor lock duration
config.description: Time required to release the motor lock between direction changes with direct motor control, in seconds

state.name: Position
state.description: Raw value of the simulated gate position as a percentage (0-100), not rounded

state.name: Target position
state.description: Target position for the current movement as a percentage, or -1 when moving to an end position

state.name: Partial open pending
state.description: Indicates that the current movement was started by a partial open command

state.name: Desired action
state.description: Pending action to perform: 0=none, 1=open, 2=close, 3=stop, 4=partial open via controller, 5=raw control pulse

state.name: Controller cycle position
state.description: Tracks the open/stop/close/stop cycle of an external controller: action the next pulse will trigger (0=open, 1=stop, 2=close, 3=stop)

state.name: Pulse phase
state.description: Phase of the pulse machinery: 0=idle, 1=pulse high, 2=pause or motor lock wait

state.name: Pulse ticks
state.description: Ticks remaining in the current pulse phase

state.name: Tick active
state.description: Indicates whether the periodic simulation callback is scheduled

state.name: Last movement timestamp
state.description: Timestamp of the last movement, used for the motor lock pause on direction change
